text:
A new repository... hundreds of files, and no idea where anything lives. So you change one word, hub becomes diagram.

GitDiagram reads the code and draws a map, every box linked straight to its real folder or file. Private repos work too, and any map exports as a picture.

Rather watch? Press video, and a narrator explains the project in about a minute, ready to download as a vertical clip.

Underneath, the server fetches the tree, the README and key source files, and one model call returns an overview and a graph.

But the model never draws the diagram itself. Every path in its graph is checked against the real tree, then plain code compiles it to Mermaid, so every box you click lands where the code lives.
